memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: 'He is to wave these before the Lord as a wave offering; they are holy and belong to the priest, together with the breast that was waved and the thigh that was presented. After that, the Nazirite may drink wine. This is the law of the Nazirite who vows offerings to the Lord in accordance with their dedication, in addition to whatever else they can afford. They must fulfill the vows they have made, according to the law of the Nazirite.' - Num 6:20-21 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The Nazirite section closes with a clear reminder: "They must fulfill the vows they have made." A vow to God was not to be taken lightly or abandoned halfway. What was promised to the Lord was to be carried out.

This underlines something important about our words to God. When we make a commitment to Him, He takes it seriously — and so should we. Scripture warns elsewhere that it is better not to make a vow than to make one and not fulfil it (Eccl 5:5). God values faithfulness and integrity in what we promise.

Notice also the phrase "in addition to whatever else they can afford." God did not demand more than a person was able to give, but He welcomed hearts that wanted to give beyond the minimum. There was room for generosity, but no crushing burden. God's requirements are never designed to break us.

And after the vow was complete, the Nazirite could drink wine again. The special season of restriction had a beginning and an end. Not every season of life looks the same. There are times of special discipline and times of ordinary living, and both can honour God.

Above all, let this leave us with a commitment to integrity: to be people whose word can be trusted, especially our word to God. Let your "yes" to God be a real yes, followed through with His help.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you keep the commitments you make to God?
- Are you a person of integrity, whose word can be trusted?
- How can you follow through on a promise you've made to God?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, help me to be faithful to the commitments I make to You. Make me a person of integrity, whose "yes" is truly yes, by Your grace. Amen.
